coins_2x.name: 2x Coins
coins_2x.description: Every squishy earns double coins, forever. Squeezes pay double too.

auto_fling.name: Auto-Throw
auto_fling.description: Throws for you every 1.5 s while you stand at your slingshot. Toggle it on the HUD.

auto_squeeze.name: Auto-Squeeze
auto_squeeze.description: Squeezes every ready squishy for you every 10 seconds.

rainbow_trail.name: Rainbow Trail
rainbow_trail.description: Your goo leaves a rainbow trail and your plot sign turns rainbow. Just for looks.

coin_bag.name: Coin Bag
coin_bag.description: 10 minutes of your income (at least 5,000 coins).

coin_jar.name: Coin Jar
coin_jar.description: 45 minutes of your income (at least 25,000 coins).

coin_tub.name: Coin Tub
coin_tub.description: 3 hours of your income (at least 120,000 coins).

squish_party.name: Squish Party
squish_party.description: 2x coins for everyone in the server for 5 minutes. Stacks up to 30 minutes.
